$comment: Recommended broadcast-system (raster / scan) identifiers used in assets.video.signal.broadcast_system. Form is <active lines><scan: i|p>/<frame rate in Hz>, e.g. 1080i/25 = 1080-line interlaced at 25 frames/s (50 fields). Prefer this raster form over legacy analogue colour-system labels (PAL/SECAM/NTSC), which do not describe an HD/UHD signal. Not enforced by the main schema; adopters may extend.

broadcast_systems.description: 1080-line interlaced, 25 frames/s (HD, 50 Hz regions) — EBU/DVB HDTV
